tasks.label: Upload Machine Node
tasks.command: PORT=$(ls /dev/cu.usbserial-* /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo "No ESP32 board found!"; exit 1; fi; echo "Uploading to $PORT..."; arduino-cli upload -p "$PORT" --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 firmware/armor_machine_node

tasks.label: Upload Badge
tasks.command: PORT=$(ls /dev/cu.usbserial-* /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo "No ESP32 board found!"; exit 1; fi; echo "Uploading to $PORT..."; arduino-cli upload -p "$PORT" --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 firmware/armor_badge

tasks.label: Serial Monitor
tasks.command: PORT=$(ls /dev/cu.usbserial-* /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then echo "No ESP32 board found!"; exit 1; fi; echo "Connecting to $PORT at 115200 baud (Press Ctrl+C to stop)..."; arduino-cli monitor -p "$PORT" -c baudrate=115200
